chunks: From him, from Safwān, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a pregnant woman who sees blood for three days or four days: should she perform salat (prayer)? He said: “She refrains from salat (prayer).”

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ: Abā al-Ḥasan, the Imam addressed in the narration

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a pregnant woman who sees blood for three or four days—does she perform salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a pregnant woman who experiences bleeding for three or four days. Imam Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام states that she should refrain from performing salat (prayer) during that time, placing the narration within the jurisprudence of menstruation-related bleeding and ritual worship.
